kxthe01.title: Delivered, 7:02 PM
kxthe01.caption: Delivered at 7:02. Silent until 3 a.m. Eleven friends, one agenda, zero double texts, and a phone that had simply died. Who in your chat reads the silence out loud?

kxthe02.title: The Situationship Summit
kxthe02.caption: Four months of just vibing, one emergency summit, and a toothbrush that was not a coincidence. Scorpio asked plainly. Who would chair the summit in your group chat?

kxthe03.title: Taurus at the Holiday Table
kxthe03.caption: The aunt asked. Taurus froze mid-bite, asked her back, and walked away with a whole love story and three containers of leftovers. Who at your table needs the reverse question?

kxthe04.title: Liked a Photo From Three Years Ago
kxthe04.caption: 1:41 a.m. One thumb, one heart, one photo from three years ago. The chat went CODE RED, then let Cancer say what they actually miss. Who is your 2 a.m. emergency contact?

kxthe05.title: The Advice Desk Is Closed
kxthe05.caption: Virgo answered 41 questions tonight and left their own text unanswered since 2:04 PM. So the chat quoted Virgo back, word for word. Which friend never asks for help?

kxthe06.title: They Ended It
kxthe06.caption: 7 p.m.: they ended it. By 3 a.m. there was soup in a car seat, the worst date story ever told and twelve people on a very quiet call. Tag the friend who stays on the call.

kxthe07.title: Four Hours to Say It
kxthe07.caption: Four hours to tell the best friend. Forty minutes lost to black holes. One breadstick eaten in fear. The ending, though. Who in your chat should say it before midnight?

kxthe08.title: Pisces Can't Sleep (Night Shift)
kxthe08.caption: First date tomorrow, fourteen voice notes tonight. The chat ran a night-shift rota: a pep talk, jam milk and a very sleepy fish story. Which sign takes the 3 a.m. shift in yours?
